thread:
maria: Heads-up — proposing we unpin runtime 3.9.x and pin runtime 4.0.0 for a canary next change window. We also need to pin SDK 3.2.1 to avoid signature/serialization mismatches. Canary window: Tue 02:00 UTC. Looking for phased plan + rollback criteria.

samir: Quick Q — what exactly broke in the last run? I saw a spike in signing errors but didn't dive deep.

maria: The KV-cache serialization format changed, plus a kernel selector tweak. Old SDKs can get rejected by the new runtime due to header signing differences. SDK 3.2.1 includes an interoperability shim to accept both formats.

alex: Ran our compatibility matrix against the quant longseq suite — 3 marginal failures (rerank edgecases) on 16k tokens. Full logs: https://internal.gist/comp-matrix/369 (ping me if you want access).

jin: Can we push a soft-fallback at the router to route mismatched signatures to runtime 3.9 instead of failing the request? Might reduce customer impact while we roll.

leah: Proposed rollout:
- Step 0: Push SDK 3.2.1 pin to client-api route (pre-deploy).
- Step 1: Deploy runtime 4.0.0 as a canary in eu-west (2:00 UTC).
- Step 2: Monitor 30min (error-rate target <0.5%, latency within 10% of baseline).
- Step 3: If OK, increase traffic to 10% for 30min, then 30% for 60min, then full regional rollout.
Rollback criteria: any sustained mismatch/errors >1% over 15m OR a regression in rerank/longseq smoke tests. I can own the monitoring channel during the window.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by maria — runtime=4.0.0, target=canary(eu-west), start=2025-03-11T02:00:00Z. Pins: sdk=3.2.1, runtime=4.0.0. Request ID: db-369-20250311.

ops-bot: Added change to pinlist (staging):
```json
{
  "route": "client-api",
  "pin": {
    "sdk": "3.2.1",
    "runtime": "4.0.0",
    "reason": "kv-serialization-interop"
  },
  "owner": "maria",
  "window": "2025-03-11T02:00:00Z"
}
```

samir: I'll prepare a rollback build that pins back to runtime 3.9 + SDK 3.1.9 and a short runbook snippet. Will post the PR in ~20m.

maria: Thanks. QA checklist: run sdk-integration-suite, longseq-quant smoke, and rerank regression. Tag me when green; I'll hold the deploy until we have a green on all 3. Post-deploy: 2h active watch.

DeployBot: Canary rollout started (db-369-20250311) — 5% traffic -> canary(eu-west).

DeployBot: Canary update: after 30m metrics: error-rate 0.2%, p95 latency +6%. Proceeding to 10% ramp.

alex: Noted one rerank regression (low-confidence ties) — opened issue #2345 and attached failing examples. It's intermittent, seems correlated with quant longseq boundary.

leah: Monitoring on watch. I'll page on-call if errors approach >0.8% or rerank/regression count >2 within 10m.

maria: If we see sticky pin/residual mismatch (clients stuck on old SDK), immediate rollback to runtime 3.9 + remove runtime pin. Follow samir's rollback PR.

DeployBot: Canary reached 10% (db-369-20250311). No automatic rollback triggered.

samir: Rollback PR ready: PR #4821 — pins back runtime 3.9, sdk 3.1.9; includes nginx routing toggle to force legacy fallback if needed.

maria: Thanks everyone — will reconvene in #eng-releases post-rollout for final notes and release blurb. :thumbsup:
